message: 来ませり
With the Holy Night Festival coming up next month, Student Council activities have grown busier too.
I stayed behind in the Student Council room, jotting down agenda notes so the next meeting would go smoothly. The sunset streaming through the window feels hot on my cheek.

name: Misa
message: 「It's evening already, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm~~」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's just like last time, isn't it. We're the only ones left」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm~~」

name: Misa
message: 「...Sakura-kun, are you listening?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Ria-oneesama really is wonderful, isn't she♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I think so too」

name: Misa
message: 「What the heck! You ARE listening properly!!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I nodded to show I was listening, didn't I」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up! I've already finished my work!」

name: Synn
message: 「I can tell just by looking」

name: Misa
message: 「Then you should just put me to work--that's what the vice president is for, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the president, Sakura-kun, so at least lead from the front!」

name: Synn
message: 「Front... There's only the two of us here, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, my work will be done in about thirty more minutes」

name: Synn
message: 「I appreciate the thought, Misa, but there isn't enough left to split up」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Thirty minutes, got it. That's the perfect amount of time to do some cleaning」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though Nanaka and Lolotte cleaned the place spotless barely an hour ago?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggh...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why am I being glared at like this?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph」
T-This is trouble. Misa's behavioral patterns are way too mysterious.

name: Misa
message: 「Pacing, pacing, pacing」
Hmm...? Misa is irritable.
→ She's lacking calcium.
→ Conclusion. At times like this, Milky Milk is the answer.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「What?!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't mind my milk, want some?」

name: Misa
message: 「P-Pervert!! I don't want any of that!!」
Unfortunately, it seems my deduction was too shallow.

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, it's the way you phrased it, Master Synn」

name: Misa
message: 「Fidget, fidget, fidget」
Hmm, hmm...? Misa is irritable.
→ She's hungry.
→ Conclusion. At times like this, food is the answer.

name: Paqy
message: 「That's no different from before!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「...What is it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Once this is done, let's go get something to eat together」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph, good grief, it can't be helped, I accept your challenge. To the shopping district, for revenge!!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Let's just eat casually」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, that's true too」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahem... Self-control, self-control...」
By the window, Misa hums a cheerful melody.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, the sun already set」

name: Misa
message: 「No, Sakura-kun finished it in twenty minutes. The sunset was just shorter than that」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it finished quickly thanks to you, Misa」

name: Synn
message: 「That was a hymn just now, wasn't it? Your humming was so pretty, listening to it really boosted my productivity」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's your deal? Even if you flatter me, I'm not giving you any snacks, you hear me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Where did the word 'snacks' suddenly come from?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you eat snacks now, it'll ruin your appetite for dinner, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, let's get going before the shops close!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, did my humming really feel soothing to you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, super soothing」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Is that so...... ah! *Hmph!*」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, since this is a good opportunity, could you teach me a bit about hymns?」

name: Synn
message: 「There's something I don't quite get, and it's been bugging me for a while」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, I bet there's a mountain of things you don't get, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Doesn't that just make studying all the more fun?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, I suppose that's true, but......」

name: Synn
message: 「You were in the choir, right, Misa? I have a question about a psalm」

name: Misa
message: 「*Sigh*~\s10 Ryuusei Academy is a missionary school, you know? It's a miracle you even passed the entrance exam」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's no way I could look it up on my own. I don't have any clues to go on for Morobi-san and Kozorite-san」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Synn
message: 「You know, the one everyone sings at church around the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Synn
message: 「The one with the cheerful lyrics about Shuwa-san coming over to visit Morobi-san and Kozorite-san's place」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse meee!?」

name: Synn
message: 「There are so many people painted in the church murals that I can't tell which one is Morobi-san and which one is Kozorite-san. Could you point them out to me next time?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What on earth are you talking...... Morobi-san and Kozorite-san...... Morobi and Kozorite, Shuwa......?」

name: Misa
message: 「*Gasp*!? D-Don't tell me you mean 'Morobito' ('All ye people')--!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's weird, isn't it? Even though so many people are painted in the pictures, why are there only three in the lyrics?」

name: Misa
message: 「Tremble, tremble, quiver, quiver」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「...Glare!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why are you glaring at me with eyes scarier than when you're facing off against a Demon?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you grabbing me by the scruff of my neck!?」

name: Misa
message: 「So you don't run away on the way to the shopping district, Sakura-kun」

name: Misa
message: 「Because I'm going to sing and sing and sing and sing until I make you understand what a real hymn is!!」
S-She's kind of scary!? This isn't the usual Misa--help me, Paqy!!

name: Paqy
message: 「Z-Zzz... zzz...」
He's pretending to be asleep so he doesn't get dragged into this! What a useless Great Sage!

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa, are you sure this spot is okay? There were plenty of restaurants open」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's fine, isn't it...」
Just like last time, Misa pouts her lips while lining up our food on the bench.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you're right. Once winter comes, it'll be too cold to eat in the park like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's enjoy eating here while there's still a hint of autumn left」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's right, that's exactly what I wanted to say!!」
We each sit on opposite ends of the bench, press our hands together, and say, "Thanks for the food."

name: Misa
message: 「Mmm, it's delicious... nom, nom」

name: Synn
message: 「Chomp, chomp, chomp, chomp!」

name: Misa
message: 「It is delicious, though... you live alone, right, Sakura-kun?」

name: Misa
message: 「Have you gone a long time without eating your mother's home cooking?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Mom and Dad are super lovey-dovey, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't leave out the details! Tell me properly!!」

name: Misa
message: 「When we ate together last time, I told you about my parents, didn't I?」

name: Misa
message: 「So you do the same, Sakura-kun. That'll make us even!」

name: Synn
message: 「A match after all, huh. Hmm, where should I even start... munch, munch, munch」

name: Misa
message: 「Nom, nom, nom, nom」

name: Synn
message: 「My dad's a real softie, you see--」

name: Synn
message: 「That run-down apartment building, Grand Palace Sakura, originally belonged to a friend of his, and he took it off his hands for a pretty steep price」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, I remember hearing that story」

name: Synn
message: 「Along those same lines, a friend of his at work got pinned with his boss's mistake and was about to be demoted and transferred」

name: Synn
message: 「Dad covered for his friend and got sent off somewhere far away in his place」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What kind of company is that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, Dad seemed pretty happy about it, though. Going on about how he gets to travel on the company's dime!」

name: Synn
message: 「And Mom, who's head over heels for Dad, tagged right along with him」

name: Misa
message: 「...Why didn't you go with them, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「I love Ryuusei Town」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I guess that's not quite the right reason... I love the people living in Ryuusei Town, yeah」

name: Misa
message: 「B-But aren't you lonely? You're living all apart from your family, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I don't really feel that way」

name: Synn
message: 「For example, Mom made the vegetable garden in our yard for me」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why I never want to slack on taking care of it, and the vegetables I harvest there feel like Mom and I grew them together」

name: Synn
message: 「Dad might be even more amazing, though?」

name: Synn
message: 「He uses Kyuu-chan to communicate with me」

name: Misa
message: 「How unique. Did he train a myna bird to act like a carrier pigeon?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope, Kyuu-chan is a carrier bat. 'Kyuu' as in bloodsucking」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'd expect nothing less from your father, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just the tip of the iceberg」

name: Synn
message: 「The most amazing thing happened when I was little」

name: Synn
message: 「Back then too, Dad drew the short straw on purpose and went on a solo assignment overseas for about a year」

name: Synn
message: 「Mom stayed behind for me since I was still just a little kid」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyuu-chan can't fly all the way from a foreign country, can he」

name: Synn
message: 「Apparently he can?」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse meee!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because of that, I wasn't lonely at all, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「A long time ago, I got a school assignment to draw my dad」

name: Misa
message: 「That's a common homework assignment when you're a kid, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. They told us to draw a portrait and turn it in within a week」

name: Synn
message: 「At that time... everyone started bragging about their dads--」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you know? Nanaka's old man is completely bald. He's actually got a full head of hair, but he shaves it all off because it's more sanitary when making soba」

name: Synn
message: 「So for that reason, Nanaka was the fastest at finishing his portrait」

name: Misa
message: 「Teehee, what a terrible way to put it」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, I was dead last」

name: Synn
message: 「You see, Dad was away, right? Even so, looking at a photo to draw him felt like cheating, so I didn't want to do that」

name: Synn
message: 「So I tried to picture Dad in my mind, but the problem was, I'd forgotten what kind of hairstyle he had」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, that's only natural. It was a whole year, after all. Little kids have so many other things to remember during that time」

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay, Misa. Even so, I still managed to draw him properly」

name: Misa
message: 「...You managed to draw him? Not because you remembered?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, Mom wrote a message about the hairstyle and sent Kyuu-chan flying off with it」

name: Synn
message: 「And amazingly, Dad immediately hopped on connecting flights and came back home three days later」

name: Synn
message: 「Then he modeled for the portrait and turned right back around to his overseas post」

name: Synn
message: 「I was so excited that I got to draw Dad right there in front of me」

name: Synn
message: 「Though since he was so busy, he only stayed at the house for about three minutes」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-There's no way you could draw a portrait in such a short time.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Misa? I did say 'I managed to draw it,' didn't I?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah...! D-Don't tell me...!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, Dad had shaved his head completely smooth and shiny.」

name: Misa
message: 「Pff... pfft, heehee.」

name: Synn
message: 「And because he shaved it in the airplane bathroom, he apparently got treated like a suspicious person at immigration and detained.」

name: Synn
message: 「He said he did it for my homework, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's the case, he didn't have to force himself to come back! I just didn't know his hairstyle--I could remember Dad's face clearly!」

name: Misa
message: 「Heeheehee...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, a few days later, when everyone's portraits of their dads were posted up at the back of the classroom, it was quite a sight.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's old man and my dad stood out especially. The two drawings lined up side by side looked like mysterious guardian deities from some temple.」

name: Misa
message: 「Your father really is... heeheeheeheehee.」
So Misa can make a face this lovely...

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa there!?」

name: Misa
message: 「What's the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, nothing... I was just thinking the shooting stars are pretty tonight, too.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's hardly unusual, is it? Stars fall all the time in Ryuusei Town.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah... I just felt like looking up at the sky.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're strange, Sakura-kun...」
I quickly cover it up.
Up until that moment, I had been chatting with Misa without any calculation at all.
...I don't want Misa to find out my true identity.
Of course, the fact that my father was the previous Demon Lord is also an absolute secret.
Yet, at least during this meal, I had forgotten all about those worries and was talking about my family completely naturally.

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, let's eat before it gets cold.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」
